status: length axis measured; width axis unresolved

unresolved.reason: Width requires focal length. Blitz uses a low, near-ground camera: the cross-field vanishing point sits ~200 image widths from centre while the down-field one sits at ~0.6, so the two are near-perpendicular from the principal point and f is not observable. 0 of 20 sampled frames had both vanishing points at usable distance.

yard_scale.method: lattice fit vs HUD down-and-distance (independent ground truth)

clip3.note: tight pre-snap view; coloured lines partly off-frame

field_length.method: HUD 'ON THE N' read by auto-decoded bitmap font; digits labelled by geometric distance measurement, no manual annotation
field_length.ceiling: hard stop at 50 across 1814 readings; no value >50 observed
field_length.inference: N counts from nearer goal line and meets at midfield => length = 2*50

caveats: Video 7 (anisotropically stretched upload) contributed only 79 of 4883 text lines.
Length rests on the football convention that 'ON THE N' counts from the nearer goal line; the hard ceiling at exactly 50 is the evidence for it.
End zone depth not measured: goal lines are visible in only ~9% of gameplay frames.
